**Opened in:** `frontend\src\app\components\game-console\game-console.component.ts`, method `openInventory()` — calls `this.dialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data: dialogData, ... })`.

**Data passed:** `InventoryDialogData { characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }`, defined/consumed in `frontend\src\app\components\inventory\inventory.component.ts` via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA` injection.

**API calls** (via `GameApiService` in `frontend\src\app\services\game-api.service.ts`):
- `getInventory(characterId)` → `GET /api/character/:id` (worker route in `worker\src\routes\character.ts`, uses `getInventory()` from `worker\src\services\character.ts`)
- `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` → `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip`
- `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` → `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId`
